description: 1st connection. Two independent checks flagged by advisor review of the 08-02 lesson draft before publish. (1) 08-02's PC-project-setup commands (A4/A6/B1/C6/C7/E3) use bare `~/...` paths, but every prior verified connection in this repo always wrote `"$HOME/..."` instead - tilde expansion under bsh (the learner's default SSH shell per P08) has never actually been tested, and this repo already found one real bsh syntax gap (the combined `export NAME=value` form, fixed in main PR #19/#20). (2) 08-02's lesson text asks the learner to re-run part07-05-checkpoint's DRIVER program against the ZAISRV that makei just rebuilt (in the part08-02-makei connection) and compare against 07-05's original 10-line output - this exact re-run was never actually done in this repo, so the lesson currently marks it V3. This reuses part07-05-checkpoint's own proven CALL/CPYSPLF/collect recipe (RUNDRIVER/CAPDRIVER steps) against the SAME &LIB DRIVER/ZAISRV/ZAISRVBD that 07-05 explicitly told the learner to keep ("ZAISRV・ZAISRVBD・DRIVERはそのまま残してください。第8部(08-02)が、このZAISRV一式をそのまま再利用します").

steps.label: CAPDRIVER
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*REPLACE)
